sarah_greeting.speaker: Receptionist Sarah
sarah_greeting.text: Welcome to Saint Cross Hospital. How may I help you?

choices.text: I'm here about my sister, Fiona. She was a patient here.

sarah_visit.speaker: Receptionist Sarah
sarah_visit.text: I see. I'm very sorry for your loss. What information do you need?

choices.text: I want to know what happened to her.
Can I see her medical records?

sarah_suspicious.speaker: Receptionist Sarah
sarah_suspicious.text: I'm sorry, sir, but visitors need to check in. This is a hospital, not a mall.

choices.text: Sorry, I'm here to see my sister.

sarah_sympathetic.speaker: Receptionist Sarah
sarah_sympathetic.text: The official report says it was complications from her surgery. I... I wish I could tell you more, but I don't have access to detailed medical information.

choices.text: Something doesn't feel right about this.

sarah_records.speaker: Receptionist Sarah
sarah_records.text: I'm afraid I can't provide medical records without proper authorization. You'd need to speak with the Records Department on the second floor.

sarah_concerned.speaker: Receptionist Sarah
sarah_concerned.text: I... I shouldn't say this, but... *looks around nervously* ...there have been a lot of sudden deaths lately. More than usual. Just... be careful, okay?

marcus_greeting.speaker: Security Guard Marcus
marcus_greeting.text: Hey there. You look lost. Can I help you find something?

marcus_routine.speaker: Security Guard Marcus
marcus_routine.text: Alright. Just make sure you have a visitor pass. We take security seriously around here.

marcus_security.speaker: Security Guard Marcus
marcus_security.text: Standard hospital protocol. Lots of expensive equipment and, you know, patient safety. Nothing to worry about if you're just here to visit.

william_greeting.speaker: William
william_greeting.text: *smiling warmly* Hey there! You look like you could use a friendly face. First time here?

choices.text: Yes, I'm looking for information about my sister.

william_helpful.speaker: William
william_helpful.text: I'm sorry to hear that. This place can be... confusing. If you need help finding your way around, I've been here a while. I know the layout pretty well.

choices.text: That would be helpful, thank you.

william_advice.speaker: William
william_advice.text: Fair enough. Just a word of advice - be careful around here at night. The staff... they're not all as friendly as they seem during the day.

william_tips.speaker: William
william_tips.text: The records room is on the second floor, but you'll need proper clearance. The mortuary is in the basement. And... *lowers voice* ...avoid the underground lab if you can. Nothing good happens down there.

william_warning.speaker: William
william_warning.text: I've said too much already. Just... trust your instincts. If something feels wrong, it probably is. And if you ever need help, come find me. I'll do what I can.
